description: Plays native video files and YouTube videos with a common playback API.

attributes.name: autoplay
attributes.description: Requests playback when the source loads; browser autoplay restrictions still apply.

attributes.name: controls
attributes.description: Shows the provider's playback controls. YouTube may still display its initial Play button.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name for the native video or YouTube iframe.

attributes.name: loop
attributes.description: Repeats the video; a looping video does not normally emit ended.

attributes.name: muted
attributes.description: Mutes the video, including when changed during playback.

attributes.name: poster
attributes.description: Image shown before native video playback; YouTube supplies its own preview.

attributes.name: preload
attributes.description: Native video preload hint. YouTube loading is controlled by its embedded player.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Native media URL or YouTube watch, share, shorts, live or embed URL. Changing it loads the new video from the beginning.

methods.name: pause(): void
methods.description: Pauses playback and cancels a queued playback request.

methods.name: play(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Requests playback. YouTube requests made before readiness are queued; its autoplay-blocked event reports browser refusal.

methods.name: seekTo(seconds: number): void
methods.description: Seeks to a nonnegative position, queuing the request while a provider loads.

events.name: tp-video-player-autoplay-blocked
events.description: Emitted when YouTube blocks a playback request. Native play() rejects its promise when blocked.

events.name: tp-video-player-ended
events.description: Emitted when a non-looping video reaches its end.

events.name: tp-video-player-error
events.description: Emitted when a source is invalid, unavailable or playback fails.
events.detail: { src: string; provider: "native" | "youtube" | ""; message: string; code?: number }

events.name: tp-video-player-ready
events.description: Emitted when native metadata or the YouTube player is ready.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

dependencies.name: tp-button
dependencies.summary: Button component that supports native button and link rendering.

dependencies.name: tp-frame
dependencies.summary: displays content in a fixed-aspect-ratio frame.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-video-player>` element plays native video files and YouTube videos with a common playback API.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Play / Pause in the video | Start or pause playback. |
| Progress bar in the video | Seek to another time when the provider allows seeking. |
| Volume / Mute in the video | Change or mute the sound when the provider exposes this control. |
| Fullscreen in the video | Show the video using the provider's fullscreen mode. |
| Open video / Watch on YouTube | Open the source in a new browser tab. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available playback controls and the source link. |
| Focused playback controls | Use the browser's or YouTube's standard keyboard interactions. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User help for the component under the pointer, falling back to the focused component. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. Move focus out of the YouTube iframe first. |
